oracle.method: enumeration of the structural noise cells of the unrolled window with exact rational arithmetic
oracle.independence_basis: Enumerating the equally likely noise cells of each declared stationary binary structural process over its unrolled window (8192 cells for the contrast process, 32768 for the mediation process), with exact rational arithmetic, evaluates the structural equations under the intervention at the treated period(s) on every cell, which gives the pulse, sustained and conditional contrasts and the total, natural direct and pure natural indirect effects with no identification formula involved. The observed window law is the count of the cells that give each observed window; the series stored in the fixture is an Eulerian circuit of the multigraph of those windows, so its consecutive windows have exactly that law, and the generator re-counts them. The textbook mediation functionals applied to the exact window law alone reproduce the enumerated mediation truths exactly. A second pair of structural models with one latent cause and the same observed law but different effects witnesses that a window holding a bow arc has no identified value. It imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the stated structural process, so a wrong coefficient in the fixture would be inherited.

reference_review.redistribution: Repository-authored MIT OR Apache-2.0 generator and deterministic inputs. Python standard library only, in an isolated locked script environment, outside the product and ordinary CI; no upstream source is stored.
reference_review.limitations: Exact arithmetic on fixed series; no sampling variability, no uncertainty or coverage claim. Graph classes, identification rules, identified-set bounds of a temporal PAG and estimator tolerances are context the generator cannot derive; the PAG cells are checked only for the enumerated truth lying in the published set. No calibration.
